scope: The 127 selected popular Shopify theme/preset records
method: Indexed public HTML evidence and direct rendered browser observations are maintained as separate source classes; interactions are counted only after execution.
reason: Live-demo page documents accessible through public web, but GUI interactions, rendering and screenshot comparison remain unverified. Former Figma Stage 6 superseded; entirely new design planned later.

priority_groups.objective: Top paid/large-catalog and premium merchandisers; inspect home/category/PDP/cart
Food, premium, high-motion and editorial behaviors
First-party free reference and native Shopify editor baseline
Remaining paid family variations and niche handling

additional_families: All 47 selected families remain in registry; priorities not exclusions.

required_evidence_per_screen.url: Actual visited live demo URL, not Theme Store listing
required_evidence_per_screen.source: Fetched public HTML and/or real screenshot
required_evidence_per_screen.notes: Observed elements, design hierarchy and merchant-facing settings (only if actually accessible)
required_evidence_per_screen.browser_render: Direct browser-rendered page structure; record whether actions, screenshots, viewport dimensions and test environment were captured.

deduplication: Avoid rechecking same URL with conflicting names; each preset can share engine but must be independently observed for layout claims.
count_semantics: Primary counts at most one read-only HTML document per host/page kind; preexisting Prestige pages do not count a second time; supplementary pages, vendor listings and independent reviews separate.
next_action: Continue with the next unobserved selected preset; coverage is 68/127 unique selected homes (51 indexed HTML + 17 browser-rendered), 67 rendered pages. 59 homes remain.
